correctness.rationale: Multiplying the generator gives the four displayed entry types. C' is an everywhere negative quadratic, by T2<=S^2 and its negative discriminant. Each hub-leaf quadratic has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant, also ruling out negative h if steps are interpreted on the whole real line. Independently expanded the leaf-minus-hub quadratic discriminant and -2(S+x+y)^3 C(3/(S+x+y)) in /workspace/checks/scalar_checks.py. The former is strictly negative since the residual spokes have B>0 and 0<U2/B^2<=1; the latter is strictly positive even at B=0 by xy<=(x+y)^2/4. These checks force the hub root to precede both other obstruction types strictly. The normalized cubic at beta is negative since beta>3/2, and at alpha it is positive since r3<=r2<1. A dominant spoke and increasingly many equal spokes converge to the respective strictly crossing scalar cubics; both limits are sharp. The code supplied with the record was inspected, not executed. This verifies the completed polynomial, not any stagewise bound.
